info.name: YugabyteDB Aeon REST Access Keys AllowLists API

params.name: accountId
params.description: The unique identifier of the YugabyteDB Aeon account.

params.name: projectId
params.description: The unique identifier of the project within the account.

items.docs: Returns all IP allow lists defined within the specified project. Allow lists control which IP addresses or CIDR ranges are permitted to connect to clusters in the project.

params.name: accountId
params.description: The unique identifier of the YugabyteDB Aeon account.

params.name: projectId
params.description: The unique identifier of the project within the account.

items.docs: Creates a new IP allow list with one or more CIDR entries. The allow list can be assigned to one or more clusters to permit inbound connections from the specified IP ranges.

params.name: accountId
params.description: The unique identifier of the YugabyteDB Aeon account.

params.name: projectId
params.description: The unique identifier of the project within the account.

params.name: allowListId
params.description: The unique identifier of the IP allow list.

items.docs: Returns details for a specific IP allow list, including its name, description, and all CIDR entries it contains.

params.name: accountId
params.description: The unique identifier of the YugabyteDB Aeon account.

params.name: projectId
params.description: The unique identifier of the project within the account.

params.name: allowListId
params.description: The unique identifier of the IP allow list.

items.docs: Permanently deletes the specified IP allow list. The allow list must not be currently assigned to any cluster before it can be deleted.
